components.css: .ds-tiles { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 6px; width: 320px; } .ds-tile { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; grid-template-areas: 'index delta' 'name name' 'time time'; align-content: space-between; gap: 6px 8px; aspect-ratio: 1; padding: 10px 12px; border: 2px solid #1d3f91; border-radius: 0; background: #ffffff; color: #1b1e24; font-family: 'Public Sans', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tile b { grid-area: index; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-tile strong { grid-area: delta; justify-self: end; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 800; } .ds-tile span { grid-area: name; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-tile small { grid-area: time; font-size: 12px; } .ds-tile:hover { background: #eef1f7; } .ds-gain { background: #1d3f91; color: #ffffff; } .ds-gain:hover { background: #2c58c4; } .ds-lost { border-bottom: 10px solid #c9782a; } .ds-lost strong { color: #9a5410; } .ds-selected { outline: 3px solid #1b1e24; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1d3f91; outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
Ghostline is painted like the tiled panels of Bom Jesus and Sameiro: cobalt fields on white glaze, with the run's data laid out as tiles. The cobalt field is the shell. It is the left rail on desktop and the header with its nav row on phone. Everything the rider reads sits on white glaze panels inside it. The world is built for a phone held on the hill in full sun, often with gloves on. Contrast is high, figures are large and tabular, and colour carries meaning before any label is read.

Colour is flat and has one meaning per hue. Cobalt means the brand, the active state, the primary action and time gained. Ochre means time lost. Everything else is ink on white with pale cobalt rules. Depth comes from frames and rules, never from shadow: a data panel earns a 2px cobalt frame, and a form groups its parts with thin rules. The reused signature is the sector tile. Each sector is a square that is filled cobalt when the rider gained time and stays white with an ochre band along its foot when time was lost. The map trace uses the same two colours, so a tile and its stretch of trail read as one fact.

The system replaces Ghostline's earlier near-black dashboard with a single neon accent.
keyCharacteristics: A committed cobalt shell: rail on desktop, header and nav row on phone.
White panels on a glaze ground, flat colour, no shadows.
Square geometry with 2px corners on controls and 0px on tiles and markers.
Cobalt means time gained, ochre means time lost, on tiles, figures and the map trace alike.
Public Sans for every role, with tabular figures throughout.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Cobalt is gain and ochre is loss, everywhere: tile, figure, map trace and share card. Never use ochre for decoration, and never use cobalt to show a loss.

rules.name: The Flat Glaze Rule
rules.body: Colour is applied flat. The only gradients in the system are the two map legend ramps, which explain the trace colours.

rules.name: The Ochre Pair Rule
rules.body: Sameiro Ochre is a fill and Burnt Ochre is its text. Never set text in Sameiro Ochre on white.

rules.name: The Sunlit Label Rule
rules.body: Labels are sentence case, untracked and at least 12px. Readability on the hill beats compactness.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every time, delta and distance uses tabular figures in Public Sans. Do not add a separate monospace face.

rules.name: The Framed Not Lifted Rule
rules.body: A surface that matters gets a cobalt frame. Nothing casts a shadow.

rules.name: The No Card-in-Card Rule
rules.body: Groups inside a card are separated by rules on white, never by grey boxes nested inside it.

dos: Do keep the shell cobalt (#1d3f91): rail on desktop, header and nav row on phone, with the active nav item as a white block with cobalt text.
Do frame data panels with a 2px cobalt border and leave quiet panels and forms at 1px.
Do show gain in cobalt and loss in ochre, with #c9782a as fill and #9a5410 as text, consistently across tiles, figures, trace and share card.
Do keep sector tiles square (1:1, 0px corners), in a 2 x 2 grid on desktop and four in a row on phone.
Do set every time and delta in Public Sans with tabular figures.
Do keep labels in sentence case, untracked and at least 12px.
donts: Don't add shadows or gradients. The map legend ramps are the only gradients.
Don't round corners beyond 2px. The avatar is the only circle.
Don't nest grey boxes inside a card. Divide groups with #dfe5f2 rules on white.
Don't set text in #c9782a on white. Use #9a5410 for loss text.
Don't introduce a second typeface, a monospace face or a dark theme.
